name: Account activity inconsistent with declared occupation or income
description: Turnover or volumes materially exceed what the customer's declared occupation, income, age or circumstances would support.
fp: Life events, gifts or a recent change of employment can explain higher activity; compare with updated KYC data.

links.name: Account holder profile mismatches activity
links.ctx: Student, pensioner or unemployed customer processes large flows.

links.name: Income level unsupported by declared profile
links.ctx: Large virtual asset turnover for a customer who declared minimal income or no source of wealth.

links.name: Sender profile does not match volume or purpose
links.ctx: Low-income or newly joined sender moves large sums with vague purpose.

links.name: Declared occupation or income inconsistent with account turnover
links.ctx: Student or unemployed applicant sees large volumes.

links.name: Account holder profile matches common recruitment demographics
links.ctx: Young, unemployed or newly arrived customers with high flows inconsistent with their stated circumstances.
links.fp: Profile alone is not suspicious and must not drive discrimination.

links.name: Deposit volumes inconsistent with customer profile
links.ctx: Cash volumes far exceed expected activity for the customer's declared occupation, income or business.
links.fp: Windfalls, asset sales or seasonal income may be genuine.
